messages:
Alex R.: Rooftop yoga tomorrow at 12:15? Also thinking of a 12:45 'stair scramble' — two short things. Mats + coffee? :sun_with_face:
Maria P.: love this. which staircase — main lobby or park steps? :thinking_face:
Dylan: park steps are longer but nicer. i'll bring a water cooler backpack. :sweat_smile:
Jamie: I can bring 6 mats. what skill level? newbie friendly? :raised_hands:
Alex R.: totally newbie friendly. 20 min gentle flow, then optional 2x3x30s stair sprints for those who want. :ok_hand:
Nadia: I made a tiny leaderboard spreadsheet — just to keep score for fun. no pressure. :tada: link: https://tiny.redwood/steps
Maria P.: I vote both. yoga then stairs. :white_check_mark:
Dylan: :thumbsup: for park steps + stairs after
Jamie: count me in. can someone snag a yoga strap? maybe @Facilities
FitBot: Weather forecast for tomorrow 12:00-13:00: light breeze, 68F, 0% precip. Rooftop OK. :sun_behind_cloud:
Alex R.: schedule block so calendar doesn't fight: ```12:15-12:35 rooftop yoga
12:35-12:45 quick change + water
12:45-13:00 stair scramble (optional)```
Maria P.: can we start at 12:10? leaves slightly more time.
Dylan: 12:10 works for me. adjusted in calendar. :calendar:
Nadia: i'll bring a tiny timer and print basic drill card (walk-jog-rest). quick rules: 3 rounds, each round 2 reps ascending, rest 90s.
Jamie: love the drill card. putting it on the fridge.
Alex R.: ok final call: 12:10 yoga on rooftop, 12:40 stairs at park steps. meet at lobby 12:05 to walk up. see y'all! :flexed_biceps:
Maria P.: woohoo. first time rooftop yoga, nervous. :grin:
Dylan: it's chill, come as you are.
FitBot: Reminder set: 12:00 tomorrow - 'Rooftop yoga + stairs' (auto-reminder). :bell:
